 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated SAP Datasphere & Analytics Cloud Developer ready to take us to the next level! If you have SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and SAP S/4HANA reporting experience and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for an SAP Datasphere & Analytics Cloud Developer to support the design, development, and optimization of enterprise reporting and analytics solutions. This position will be Full-Time and Remote . 

 Only candidates with work authorization that does not require sponsorship now or in the future will be considered. 

 What You'll Do 
 Analyze existing SAP S/4HANA SQVI queries and reporting requirements and transform them into scalable, reusable SAP Datasphere data models, views, and transformations
 Design, build, and maintain SAP Datasphere solutions that support centralized enterprise reporting and analytics initiatives
 Establish, monitor, and optimize SAP S/4HANA data connections, extraction processes, replication jobs, and data integration workflows
 Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) to support business decision-making
 Migrate legacy SQVI reports and manually maintained reporting processes into standardized SAP Datasphere and SAC solutions
 Validate and reconcile data across SAP S/4HANA, Datasphere, and SAC environments to ensure accuracy and consistency
 Troubleshoot reporting, data quality, and performance issues while implementing continuous improvements to reporting solutions
 Support data governance, security, user access controls, and compliance standards across analytics platforms
 Create and maintain technical documentation for data models, reporting logic, data flows, and system dependencies
 Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical resources to gather requirements, conduct testing, and deliver reporting enhancements
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Hands-on experience developing solutions with SAP Datasphere
 Experience creating dashboards, reports, and visualizations using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
 Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA data structures, reporting, and integration concepts
 Experience designing data models, views, transformations, and analytical datasets
 Knowledge of data extraction, replication, and integration processes between SAP systems and analytics platforms
 Experience troubleshooting data quality, reconciliation, and reporting discrepancies
 Strong SQL and data modeling skills
 Experience with data governance, security, and access control principles
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
 Ability to work independently in a remote consulting environment
 Preferred:
 Experience migrating SAP QuickViewer (SQVI) reports to enterprise analytics solutions
 Experience supporting enterprise reporting modernization initiatives
 Knowledge of SAP BW, SAP HANA, or related SAP analytics technologies
 Experience working in Agile project environments
 Familiarity with performance optimization techniques for SAP Datasphere models and SAC reporting assets
 Experience creating technical documentation and conducting user acceptance testing
 
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
 Must be able to communicate with customers/team members over the phone and in person
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
